articles.title: Russia builds doomsday nuclear bunker in remote mountain to launch strikes against West
articles.description: Hidden in the remote Ural Mountains of central Russia, the tiny village of Kytlym has an unusually busy military presence.
articles.content:
Putin has resurrected a sinister Cold War nuclear system designed to ensure Russia can unleash a retaliatory strike even if a devastating attack wipes out its leadership.
